name: Wit of the Braided River
body:
School evocation [force]; Level: jester 8

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 immediate action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (190 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: One creature rolling to attack
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target takes 1d8 points of force damage +1 point per caster level, and the target’s attack misses.

Until the end of combat, each time you make a saving throw, you may roll twice and take the higher result.
